title: Indian Americans are closing a billion-dollar philanthropy gap
sources: Dalberg, October 30, 2025 - Indian American Philanthropy Narrows Giving Gap from $2-3 Billion to Just $1 Billion
American Bazaar, October 31, 2025 - Indian American giving nears $5 billion, narrowing philanthropic gap to historic low
caption:
The Indian diaspora doesn't just earn abroad. A new report says it's closing a billion-dollar philanthropy gap to become one of America's most generous immigrant communities.

Indian American philanthropic giving reached an estimated $4-5 billion in 2024, nearly tripling since 2018, per a joint report from Dalberg, Indiaspora and the India Philanthropy Alliance published October 30, 2025. The gap between what the community could give and what it actually gives has narrowed from $2-3 billion down to just $1 billion. The same report projects that if the next generation gives even 1% of an estimated $2 trillion in coming wealth transfer, annual giving could reach $20 billion - a projection, not a guarantee.

Earning abroad was never the whole story. This is what the diaspora is choosing to give back - and the gap keeps closing.

Sources: Dalberg, American Bazaar (2025)
